assessment: Five-year test: the thesis holds without the latest events. The go-along-then-reverse pattern is built on the 2024 publisher episode and the 2024 to 2025 Los Angeles year. The September 27 management report, the October 1 sketch and the October 6 allegation are used as limits, as fenced-off disputes or as settle signals, not as proof. Dating is strong: nearly every fact has an absolute date, chart peaks are tied to a dated report, the tours are described as announced, not under way, and each quotation names its outlet and date in prose, so attribution survives dead links. The one serious weakness is future-01, where an unconfirmed, anonymously sourced report is written as her decision in the settle section and FAQ. The rest are small: undated statuses (age, father's title, a relationship, "now", "next", "unreleased"), a duration in the type answer that contradicts the draft's own dates, and gaps in the evidence record (no claim for the site-typing sentence or the relationship, two claims labeled stable that are not, event-only triggers on the allegations, and no review date after the 2027 tour). Open-case eligibility: met on the record supplied (adult, 24; breakout January to March 2026; 33 sources opened and four types tested). Title, description and FAQs keep to leading-read language, alternatives are argued with evidence for and against, and the five settle signals are concrete and dated. No eligibility blocker. Similarity: the advisory did not trip. Its leads are shared Nine vocabulary ("going along") and one-line type descriptions; on the excerpts given, the argument here, a dated sequence held as an open question, is its own. No reuse finding. The top scores (0.046, 0.045) equal the corpus noise-floor maximum and sit just above the stated 0.044 threshold while tripped is false, which is worth a look in the tool. Limits of this review: I compared against the diagnostic's excerpts only, did not reopen external sources, and did not check the four internal comparison pages.
